derivation: Street-side profile taken from the two independent December 2015 positions, checked against 2018 Antigng. Hidden returns close the visible roof fragments at an estimated local cut. Coordinates are metres relative to the plaster wall. The cutting depth of the main roof is independent of the city parcel.

photo_measurement.resolution_limit: Right-hand sill is partly hidden behind winter branches. The light-coloured panel below the dark frame belongs to the facade. In the summer oblique picture the projecting air conditioner conceals most of the second opening.
photo_measurement.independent_check: First opening checked in the winter west oblique and the summer photograph. Selection of bottom and top jamb corners in the two-camera fit gives approximate wall depths of 0.53–0.71m.

eastern_finish: White gable, recessed dark two-leaf frame, narrow green-grey sill. The casing of a post-construction appliance partly covers the photographed aperture; the interior is not known.
western_finish: Two discrete recessed dark openings and two projecting drying racks supported by brackets. In December 2015 the eastern leaf of the westernmost opening shows an outward swing, while fine sash members are partly obscured in July 2018.
dimensional_limits: Seven triangulated details across the gable fronts place the visible front plaster close to the wall plane, within -0.13 to +0.02 m. Upper rake projections, unseen tile backs and return cuts are estimates. Relative roof height is more reliable than the pavement datum.

glazing_layout.evidence: Front rectifications of the 2015 eastern dormer aperture, the 2018 western left frame and the 2015 connecting sash all show a narrow upright midway across each leaf. Two horizontal glazing bars subdivide the clear height. Upper corners of the connecting and outer western panes are partly covered.
